Subject: Enterprise access cutover: SSO/SCIM, IP gating & service-account patterns (kickoff)

Hi Julia / FinArc IT —

Thanks for agreeing to the cutover window next week. To make the onboarding frictionless I put together a concise ops checklist and a few decision points we need to lock before the cutover: attached (ent-access-cutover-checklist.pdf).

Key items we want to confirm in this thread:
- SAML IdP metadata exchange and expected attributes (email, name, roles)
- SCIM provisioning: endpoint, auth token rotation cadence, and user->group mapping
- IP allowlist: outbound IP ranges FinArc will accept from Redwood, and FinArc inbound IPs we should whitelist for admin callbacks
- Service account patterns: naming, least-privilege scopes, and rotation policy
- Org policies: session length, enforced MFA, and delegated admin tiers

Proposed timeline:
- Wed 10/6: final metadata + SCIM test credentials
- Thu 10/7: SCIM provisioning dry-run in staging
- Fri 10/8: production cutover window (2–4pm PT) with rollback slot at 3:45pm

Action: Julia — can you confirm SCIM endpoint + an initial test account that we can provision? Also send the IP allowlist you want Redwood to use.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with engineering for the SAML metadata exchange and service-account templates.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Enterprise access cutover: SSO/SCIM, IP gating & service-account patterns (kickoff)

Thanks Priyom — quick answers below.

SCIM: endpoint is https://api.finarc.com/scim/v2, we will provide a scoped token for the staging dry-run (token will be rotated prior to production). See attached minimal spec excerpt (finarc-scim-spec.json) for expected attributes and group handling.

SAML: we can accept Redwood SP metadata at any time; our team prefers Email (NameID) and a groups attribute for entitlements.

IP allowlist: for admin callbacks please use 34.82.10.0/24 and 34.82.11.0/24 (prod). For staging, use 34.82.20.0/24.

Service accounts: we want a clear pattern that includes env + team + role (example: redwood-prod-cs-ingest). Rotation policy is 90 days, and tokens should be auditable.

We can provide a staging test account (test-admin@finarc.com) by EOD today.

Julia
Head of IT Operations | FinArc
Attachments: finarc-scim-spec.json
